definition: per world: annualized daily Sharpe (mean/sd ddof=1 * sqrt(252)) of r_t = dE_t / 10,000 from the warm-up end to the path end (spread included, no swap / commission, stop-out as in the model); target = mean over the worlds (no concatenation); bisection on the scale until |mean - target| <= tolerance / 4 (accepted up to tolerance)
